entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for price to get back into that FVG
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to retrace back into the fair value gap before entering for continuation.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says to patiently wait for price to return to the FVG and tap in.

stop.transcript_quote: put your stop loss a little bit below the fair value gap
stop.rationale: For buys, the stop is 'a little bit below the fair value gap'; for sells, 'a little bit above'.

confluences.name: trend_matters
confluences.description: Pay attention to the trend because 'the probability of your treads playing out when you are sticking to the trend is higher'

confluences.transcript_quote: it must also create a break of structure
confluences.name: break_of_structure
confluences.description: Use the FVG that 'must also create a break of structure'.

confluences.transcript_quote: prefer the FVG close to the order block
confluences.name: fvg_near_ob
confluences.description: The speaker says to focus on 'the FVG that is very close to the order block'.
